Introduction

Seungjoo is a South Korean singer and dancer under iNKODE. She is a member of the girl group SAY MY NAME.

She is best known for being a contestant on MBC' survival show My Teenage Girl, where she was eliminated after ranking 15th place.

Seungjoo made her debut with SAY MY NAME on October 16, 2024 with the release of their first mini album "SAY MY NAME".
